findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate · Private data: make_cartoon, get_guide, validate, share_link · Public sink: make_cartoon, validate, share_link, report_problem · Destructive: build.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate · Private data: make_cartoon, get_guide, validate, share_link · Public sink: make_cartoon, validate, share_link, report_problem · Destructive: build

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
